Jwt._comment: Development only. On the factory server HTTPS is required — see specification section 15.

Cors._comment: The Vite development server. In production the API serves the React files itself, so no cross-origin request happens.
Cors._localNetwork: Lets a phone or tablet on the same network open the screens while developing. Private addresses only, never a wildcard, and ignored outside Development.

Seed._comment: Demonstration accounts, one per job, all sharing one password. Development only — the code refuses to create them anywhere else. Turn off before the factory uses the system for real.
